name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
eligibility_summary: Top 20th percentile in Class 12 board examination with annual family income <= INR 4,50,000, pursuing regular UG degree.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
eligibility_summary: Female student admitted to 1st year technical degree course in AICTE approved institution with family income <= INR 8,00,000.

name: ICAI Need-Based & Economically Needy Students Scholarship
provider: Board of Studies, The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India
eligibility_summary: Enrolled CA students (Foundation/Inter/Final) with parental annual income <= INR 5,00,000.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)
provider: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Maharashtra
eligibility_summary: Domiciled Maharashtra students admitted through CAP with annual family income <= INR 8,00,000.

name: Post Matric Scholarships Scheme for Minorities
provider: Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India
eligibility_summary: Minority community students with >= 50% marks in previous final exam and family income <= INR 2,00,000.

name: AIIMS B.Sc Nursing Merit-cum-Means Financial Assistance
provider: All India Institute of Medical Sciences New Delhi
eligibility_summary: Enrolled B.Sc Nursing students with demonstrated low economic background or reserved category.

name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
eligibility_summary: OBC/EBC/DNT students pursuing post-matric courses with parental annual income <= INR 2,50,000.
